answer: Inlet Burn Queue admits at most 40 new identities per epoch, and each applicant must burn 1,200 POA for an entry ticket plus pass a Whisper liveness check proving one device per identity. The Atlas sponsor graph publishes every identity sponsor chain, so a cluster of 500 fakes sharing one sponsor is visible before it earns anything. Burning tickets for 500 fakes costs 600,000 POA upfront, the 40-per-epoch cap stretches the attack over 13 epochs, and a failed Whisper check forfeits the ticket, so mass fakery burns money months before any payout.
